sounds.text: Short sentences, close to speech. He teaches by asking the room a question, then tells a story and checks the room.

told.statement: We were told Jose is Panamanian and writes in plain, short, strong sentences. We have not yet heard either from him.
told.note: The recordings do not yet show him saying where he is from, and we have found no writing by him. Both wait for his own words.

panama.note: No flag, map, hat or canal until Jose's own words about Panama are chosen. What the recordings hold so far is business and country talk:
